name: Basics of Public Policy Research
description:
Public Administration is the study of the management, operation, and functioning
of government bodies and organizations in the public sector. As such, it is not
unique: other disciplines study this subject as well. Public Administration (PA)
distinguishes itself, though, by analysing the public sector from several angles in
an integrated manner. In other words, it is interdisciplinary in character,
employing knowledge from various disciplines in an integrated manner – or at
least it is a multidisciplinary form of research, which applies the insights from
different disciplines to one and the same subject.

Apart from its interdisciplinary approach, Public Administration research has
three other distinctive features. These unique features all influence the way in
which research is conducted.
Public organizations rely heavily on accurate data to make timely decisions regarding budgets, public policy, program implementation and general organization priorities. 
In order to accomplish these objectives, public administrators must quickly collect, analyze and interpret data.

name: Fundamentals of Public Policy
description: This course offers an introduction to public policy. It will introduce what is public policy and discuss its relevance as a discipline. The course then introduces the key circumstances under which a problem becomes a public policy issue. It offers that market failures are the main areas that require public policy action to be initiated. However, it contends that there are different kinds of market failures. Therefore, each kind of market failure is discussed in detail. In the end, a problem set is shared to solve that provides practical questions on public policy issues.

description: This course delves into the connections between governance and national development, focusing on topics like monitoring, evaluation, systems, accountability and incentives in public governance. name: Understanding Development Programs

name: Essential Tools for Monitoring and Management for Everyone
description: The "Everyday DataScience" course is a comprehensive program that equips participants with practical skills and knowledge in data analysis, visualization, and interpretation. Throughout the course's 19 modules,  participants will gain hands-on experience by working with real data from MORD Schemes.  Participants will learn to clean and manipulate data using Excel, create effective visualizations and charts, communicate data insights, and work with various tools for data presentation. They'll also gain an understanding of indicator selection, ranking, and the development of composite indices. By the end of the course, participants will be able to confidently analyze data, extract valuable insights, and communicate their findings effectively, making data-driven decisions across different scenarios.

name: Detailed Project Report
description: This 90-minute e-learning course on Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) is designed for infrastructure and construction professionals by the National Institute of Chartered Program/Project Professionals (NICPP). The course will provide a comprehensive understanding of DPRs, their importance, and the key components required to create effective DPRs for infrastructure projects. Participants will gain the knowledge and skills necessary to create, review, and manage DPRs effectively. Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) stand as the bedrock of successful project management. These reports, often seen as the architect's blueprint for a successful project, contains a wealth of information crucial for decision-making, risk mitigation, and resource optimization. At their core, DPRs offer a panoramic view of a project, capturing its intricacies and complexities. The content within these reports is meticulously crafted to provide stakeholders, project managers, and investors with a thorough understanding of the project's scope, objectives, and potential challenges. This section acts as a gateway for busy executives and stakeholders, offering a quick grasp of the project's key components. Following this, the Project Description section dives into the details, project's goals, scope, and limitations. This part of the DPR provides project managers with a foundational understanding, allowing them to set realistic expectations and form the project's purpose with clarity.

name: Fundamentals of Program and Project Management
description:
The NICPP Level 0 provides the basics of Program/Project Management (PM) for infrastructure projects. Conceptualized as “InBoK+” the certification shall align a candidate with the foundational overview of Indian Infrastructure Body of Knowledge (InBoK) and allied concepts in infrastructure.
Advocated and designed by the veterans in the industry, academia and also practiced at leading infrastructure consultancies/construction firms around the globe - Level 0 shall strengthen a candidate’s foundations in program/project management in the infrastructure sector.
Ideal for beginners and professionals alike, candidates from any academic background can undergo this certification program.

name: Introduction: Basics of Project Management
description:
The 90-Minute Project Management Course, developed by the Quality Council of India (QCI), offers a condensed yet comprehensive overview of the essential principles and practices of project management. Designed as a synopsis of the training modules developed for Level 1 and Level 0 of the prestigious National Institute of Chartered Program/Project Professionals (NICPP) certification, this course provides participants with a solid foundation to manage projects across various industries effectively.

Throughout this dynamic and engaging 90-minute session, participants will gain valuable insights into key project management concepts, tools, and techniques. The course is specifically tailored to fit the needs of busy professionals seeking to enhance their project management skills without committing to extensive training.

name: Introduction to Quality Control in FCI

name: Six Sigma Fundamentals
description: Welcome to the "Six Sigma Fundamentals" module! We are thrilled to guide you through the intricacies of Six Sigma, a methodology renowned for its impact on process improvement. In this course, you will not only define Six Sigma but also trace its evolution through historical contexts. The DMAIC methodology takes center stage, offering a structured approach to problem-solving, and you'll delve into its phases with a focus on key activities and associated tools. Statistical tools form a vital part of Six Sigma, and you'll gain proficiency in applying them for effective analysis and addressing process variations. The program concludes by exploring continuous improvement techniques like Kaizen and PDCA, demonstrating their practical application through a compelling case study.

name: Public Policy Writing
